cond_0001.intro: Responsible for electrical, electronic and computer control systems used in projects worked on by the Corporate Engineering group. Works individually or with a project team to upgrade, design and build control systems. This may include outside contractors or working with other [Company name masked] departments such as data processing or manufacturing branches.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop concepts for machine control. Program/change machine controls and PLC's. Serve as team leader, providing direction for [Company name masked] employees and outside contractors. Negotiate with vendors and contractors outside the company. Work with manufacturing to identify their needs. Work primarily in an engineering office environment. Work in machine shop, or plant where machines, their components, and other process testing is being performed. A major challenge of the position involves the maintenance of necessary knowledge and skill level associated with various types of machine control equipment and operator interfaces.
Investigate and generate ideas related to industrial processes and machinery controls. This is frequently performed in conjunction with the Chief Electrical Engineer and Vice President of Engineering and members of a project team.
Design and create industrial processes and machine control systems.
Compile estimated and actual costs for the design and manufacture of control systems.
Negotiate with and oversee work performed by outside contractors and vendors.
Design tests, research ideas and evaluate new approaches and materials related to control systems.
Create specification documents. Create electrical, electronic and engineering drawings, machine control system descriptions, flow charts and sketches.
Create computer programs needed for control systems.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5-10 Years minimum experience in the programming and control of industrial machinery and processes.
PLC programming experience using Allen Bradley RSlogix softwares and Studio 5000.
Graphical HMI programming with FactoryTalk View and/or Wonderware.
Experience in electrical controls hardware design, including safety systems.
Strong mechanical aptitude and computer skills.
Ability to travel 20%-30%.
Preferred Requirements
Siemens PLC using Step 7.
Experience with AC drives such as Allen Bradley Powerflex series, and SEW Eurodrive.
Experience drawing in AutoCad.
Experience with Fanuc and ABB robots; programming via teach pendant.

Strong mechanical aptitude and computer skills are required.

Completion of a bachelor's degree.

Work is carried out individually or alongside a project team to upgrade, design, and build control systems, which may involve outside contractors or coordination with other [Company name masked] departments such as data processing or manufacturing branches.
cond_0108.responsibilities:
Collaborate with the Chief Electrical Engineer, Vice President of Engineering, and project team members to investigate and generate ideas related to industrial processes and machinery controls.
Work with the team to design and develop industrial processes and machine control systems.
Coordinate with manufacturing to understand their needs and help translate them into control system requirements.
Compile estimated and actual costs for the design and manufacture of control systems, sharing findings with relevant stakeholders.
Work alongside outside contractors and vendors, helping to align their work with project requirements.
Coordinate on design tests, research ideas, and evaluate new approaches and materials related to control systems.
Contribute to specification documents, electrical and electronic drawings, machine control system descriptions, flow charts, and sketches.
Develop computer programs needed for control systems, working with the broader project team as needed.
Help develop concepts for machine control and support programming and changes to machine controls and PLCs.
cond_0108.requirements:
5-10 Years minimum experience in the programming and control of industrial machinery and processes.
PLC programming experience using Allen Bradley RSlogix software and Studio 5000 required.
Siemens PLC using Step 7 is strongly preferred.
Graphical HMI programming with FactoryTalk View and/or Wonderware is required.
Experience with AC drives such as Allen Bradley Powerflex series and SEW Eurodrive is preferred.
Experience drawing in AutoCAD.
Experience in electrical controls hardware design, including safety systems.
Experience with Fanuc and ABB robots; programming via teach pendant.
Strong mechanical aptitude and computer skills are required.
Ability to travel 20%-30%.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
More than ten years' experience required to perform the job.

cond_0145.intro: Responsible for electrical, electronic and computer control systems used in projects worked on by the Corporate Engineering group. Works individually or with a project team to upgrade, design and build control systems. This may include outside contractors or working with other [Company name masked] departments such as data processing or manufacturing branches.
cond_0145.responsibilities:
Develop concepts for machine control. Program/change machine controls and PLC's. Serve as team leader, providing direction for [Company name masked] employees and outside contractors. Negotiate with vendors and contractors outside the company. Work with manufacturing to identify their needs. Work primarily in an engineering office environment. Work in machine shop, or plant where machines, their components, and other process testing is being performed. A major challenge of the position involves the maintenance of necessary knowledge and skill level associated with various types of machine control equipment and operator interfaces.
Investigate and generate ideas related to industrial processes and machinery controls. This is frequently performed in conjunction with the Chief Electrical Engineer and Vice President of Engineering and members of a project team.
Design and create industrial processes and machine control systems.
Compile estimated and actual costs for the design and manufacture of control systems.
Negotiate with and oversee work performed by outside contractors and vendors.
Design tests, research ideas and evaluate new approaches and materials related to control systems.
Create specification documents. Create electrical, electronic and engineering drawings, machine control system descriptions, flow charts and sketches.
Create computer programs needed for control systems.
cond_0145.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5-10 Years minimum experience in the programming and control of industrial machinery and processes.
PLC programming experience using Allen Bradley RSlogix softwares and Studio 5000.
Graphical HMI programming with FactoryTalk View and/or Wonderware.
Experience in electrical controls hardware design, including safety systems.
Strong mechanical aptitude and computer skills.
Ability to travel 20%-30%.
Preferred Requirements
Siemens PLC using Step 7.
Experience with AC drives such as Allen Bradley Powerflex series, and SEW Eurodrive.
Experience drawing in AutoCad.
Experience with Fanuc and ABB robots; programming via teach pendant.

Work is carried out individually or alongside a project team to upgrade, design, and build control systems, which may involve outside contractors or coordination with other [Company name masked] departments such as data processing or manufacturing branches.
cond_0522.responsibilities:
Collaborate with the Chief Electrical Engineer, Vice President of Engineering, and project team members to investigate and generate ideas related to industrial processes and machinery controls.
Work with the team to design and develop industrial processes and machine control systems.
Coordinate with manufacturing to understand their needs and help translate them into control system requirements.
Compile estimated and actual costs for the design and manufacture of control systems, sharing findings with relevant stakeholders.
Work alongside outside contractors and vendors, helping to align their work with project requirements.
Coordinate on design tests, research ideas, and evaluate new approaches and materials related to control systems.
Contribute to specification documents, electrical and electronic drawings, machine control system descriptions, flow charts, and sketches.
Develop computer programs needed for control systems, working with the broader project team as needed.
Help develop concepts for machine control and support programming and changes to machine controls and PLCs.
cond_0522.requirements:
5-10 Years minimum experience in the programming and control of industrial machinery and processes.
PLC programming experience using Allen Bradley RSlogix software and Studio 5000 required.
Siemens PLC using Step 7 is strongly preferred.
Graphical HMI programming with FactoryTalk View and/or Wonderware is required.
Experience with AC drives such as Allen Bradley Powerflex series and SEW Eurodrive is preferred.
Experience drawing in AutoCAD.
Experience in electrical controls hardware design, including safety systems.
Experience with Fanuc and ABB robots; programming via teach pendant.
Strong mechanical aptitude and computer skills are required.
Ability to travel 20%-30%.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
More than ten years' experience required to perform the job.
cond_0522.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0522.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.
